policy.notes: Production renders cycle only through the small approved Mixkit stock set. A music file is usable only when this database has an approved rights record with preserved evidence.

musicMix.notes: Measured integrated loudness from ffmpeg ebur128. Render gains normalize each approved bed to 20% of the sampled Chatterbox narration signal (about 14 LU below the -24 LUFS narration reference), so music remains background audio rather than competing with speech.
